issues.quote: «بند ۱: «هنمودهایی» غلط تایپی است؛ در خلاصه «رهنمودهایی» آمده است»
issues.explanation: Evidence S23682-007 (clause 1, pdf 11 / printed 1) is transcribed — by the verified process — as «ارائهٔ رهنمودهایی دربارهٔ استفاده از هوش مصنوعی است». No form «هنمودهایی» appears in any evidence item from clause 1. The verified transcription is authoritative on letter-level accuracy; the typo claim is therefore unsupported.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove the notation about «هنمودهایی» unless an evidence item showing that exact spelling in the clause 1 page image is added to the evidence set.

issues.explanation: F23682-شکل ۴ records «عدم توضیح‌پذیری ML» without any parenthetical, and S23682-118 (clause 6.7.4) likewise shows «عدم توضیح‌پذیری» alone. No evidence item contains the pairing with «(توصیف‌پذیری)». The claim that this parenthetical appears in the printed text is unsupported.
